title: AXI Burst Type vs Response Coverage
description: Inspect an illustrative burst/response cross. EXOKAY bins are conditional on an exclusive transaction and its full restriction set; burst type alone does not make the response legal or illegal.

bins.tooltip: Missing test: Issue a WRAP burst to a memory region.

Conditional coverage hole: EXOKAY is permitted only for a successful exclusive access. Check AxLOCK and all exclusive span, alignment, attribute, and matching-read/write restrictions before counting this bin.
Successful exclusive INCR access. The full exclusive restriction set, not INCR by itself, makes this legal.
Successful exclusive WRAP access. Confirm total-byte alignment, legal span, matching read/write attributes, and monitor support.
FIXED burst to a peripheral that returned a Slave Error.
INCR burst to a peripheral that returned a Slave Error.
Missing test: WRAP burst to a region that returns SLVERR.
FIXED burst to an unmapped address.
Missing test: INCR burst to an unmapped address.
WRAP burst to an unmapped address.
